applications.description: Comprehensive mixed-use redevelopment of the site including the demolition of the existing buildings and construction of seven new buildings comprising residential dwellings (Use Class C3), residential co-living homes (Use Class Sui Generis), commercial and community uses (Class E (excluding sub-use B), F2 and sui generis - creative industries), new public square and other public realm improvements, car parking, cycle parking, internal and external private and communal amenity space, play space, access and servicing arrangements, plant, substations, and other associated works incidental to the proposed development.(This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement)ÿFurther explanation (not forming part of the formal description of development set out above): ÿThe proposed development includes the construction of seven new buildings to provide 464 residential dwellings (Use Class C3) and 421 co-living homes (Use Class sui generis), comprising heights of between 2, 8, 10, 20, 23 and 29 storeys (up to 123.66 AODm), as well as a single storey workspace building. affordableHousingSupply.note: Win condition uses this completions pace, not the London Plan 35% policy target.

nursePay.hcas: Inner London 20% of basic, min £5,794 max £8,746 from 1 April 2026
nursePay.note: Outer London HCAS is lower than Inner. Take-home still uses the Inner Band 5 entry figure until we re-derive Outer 2026/27 — not an invented Outer salary.

takeHomeAssumptions.note: Transparent 2026/27 England PAYE sketch for the nurse only (NHS pension). Private renter has no pension deduction in this model. Not official tax tables.

nurse.label: Band 5 nurse
nurse.housing: houseshare at 42% of PIPR 1-bed (full 1-bed already exceeds 40% take-home at baseline)

renter.label: Private renter
renter.incomeNote: Modelled inner-London professional salary for the scenario, not ASHE/median. Tenure mix (36.2% PRS) is 2018.

family.label: Family of four
family.incomeNote: Two Inner London Band 5 entry salaries as a visible public-service household, not a household-income survey.

stakes.snapshotNote: Official snapshot, not live. TA not in this pack unless extracted per borough — do not use Tower Hamlets 3,096 here.

crimeNote: Street-crime counts are precomputed per application from data.police.uk May 2026. No point cloud shipped.
